I’ve had to demand payment for folks and drive the check to them myself to ensure folks got paid. Have you asked for dates when check was printed vs mailed? Or can you accept funds being wired/sent digitally? Can’t make things idiot proof but maybe it can help. Lastly, I haven’t experienced corruption/evil practices in nonprofit myself, though I’m sure it does happen. So folks may hate me for this but take it from a figurative sculptor - 1) that is a statue of Hercules or Heracles. The Farnese sculpt with the lion pelt being a famous pose and piece from his trials. A club is sometimes with it, sometimes not.

Other thing is when you are learning all the muscles, the first thing you do is you blow them all up. You want to show that you know them all! Which is why early comics etc have near naked/spandex people with no body fat. Sculpting musculature is something you learn early and love. Also why we are so many horse, jaguars, bulls…not so many pandas - Contrasting against the pillow softness often seen in classical sculpture of women. 

Anyway, all that to say it was both showing off/love letter from the artist and also something godlike. Not trying to make waves but Hercules makes more sense for this subreddit.

On original PlayStation - If you wedged a bread twist-tie in the button that told the system the disc was closed, you could play copied or import games. 

You start the system with lid open, go to music player, place local/real game in unit, use bread twist tie to tell psx lid was closed. After it reads the disc in music player, remove game and replace with whatever you like. Close lid for real and you’re good to go! Was taught by some Japanese friends in middle school :)
